title: Delivery areas and charges
intro: One band per area, simple. Dhaka City is the official city-corporation map; your sub-area list is the only exception to it; everywhere else is one flat charge. The address decides the band by itself — the courier never changes what the customer pays.
sample: This shop is still on the sample area list (public place names only). The full national list is loaded later; your bands and your sub-area list stay as they are.

bands.title: Three delivery bands
bands.sub: What the customer pays — the address decides the band by itself
bands.offNote: Off: checkout asks the customer and shows no charge from this band until you switch it on.
bands.none: This shop has no delivery bands yet. They come with the shop's first set-up.
bands.note: Which courier carries the parcel only changes the shop's own cost, never what the customer pays.
bands.subSwitchHelp: Off: the places on your list are charged by the map (Dhaka City or outside) until you switch it on.
bands.subOffNote: Off — your list is kept; its places pay the map's charge for now.
bands.subTurnedOff: Sub-area band switched off — its places go by the map
bands.needCharge: Type its charge first: press “Change”, fill the charge and switch it on there.

edit.title: {name}
edit.desc: These are your own figures. A band is switched on only together with its charge, so a customer never sees a charge nobody typed.
edit.chargeHelp: What the customer pays for this band. 0 means free delivery.
edit.hoursHelp: Shown as the delivery promise at checkout, for example 24–48 hours.
edit.enabled: Switched on — customers in this band are charged this
edit.codHelp: A bigger order in this band cannot pay cash on delivery; the customer pays online instead. Empty = no limit.

list.title: Areas
list.sub: Find a place to open it: rename it, edit its spellings, move it to another band or merge it with another spelling of the same place. Your list below is the exception to the map.
list.empty: Nothing on your list yet. Every place outside the Dhaka City map is charged as outside Dhaka.
list.added: {name} is now in the sub-area band
list.missing: No longer in the area list
list.mine: Your list (the exception to the map)

errors.CHARGE_REQUIRED: Type the charge before switching the band on.
errors.MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only the sub-area band has this choice.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not change this. Ask the owner for the permission.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.badCharge: Type the charge as a number, for example 80.
errors.badHours: Hours are whole numbers, the fastest not above the slowest.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.badCod: Type the cash-on-delivery limit as a number, or leave it empty.
errors.DUPLICATE_PLACE: A place of that name is already there. Open that one instead, or pick another name.
errors.LEVEL_MISMATCH: Only two places of the same kind merge (an area into an area, an upazila into an upazila).
errors.BAND_CONFLICT: These two places sit in different bands on your list. Move one first, then merge.

try.title: Try an address
try.sub: Type an address as a customer would. It is read the way checkout reads it: only when you stop typing or leave the box.
try.label: Address
try.both: We can see {a} and {b} in it — which one is right?
try.changed: The address now reads as {place}, but {band} was chosen. Which one is right?
try.wide: {place} holds more than one band — which part?
try.none: No place found in it yet — the customer picks the band.
try.placeUnsure: Two places of this name are both charged like this.

pageSub: Three bands: Dhaka City (the city-corporation map), the sub-area band (your own list) and outside Dhaka. The address decides the band by itself; the courier never changes what the customer pays.

place.title: {name}
place.keepOld: Keep the old name as a spelling, so old addresses still find it
place.spellingsHelp: One per line — how customers also write it (Gabtoli, গাবতলি…). Checkout and the search read every one.
place.byMap: By the map (not on your list)
place.bandHelp: Moving a place takes everything inside it along. “By the map” takes it off your list (kept, never deleted).
place.mergeHelp: When the list has the same place twice. This one is archived (never deleted); its names become spellings of the other, the places inside it move across, and saved customer addresses follow. Placed orders keep what they had.
place.mergeSameKind: Only places of the same kind are shown.

add.title: Add a place
add.desc: For a place the area list does not have yet (a new housing, a market people name). It sits inside the place you pick.
add.needParent: Pick the place it sits in first.
